Polling interval help: How often devices without WebSocket are polled and how long the adapter waits before reconnecting.
Max retry attempts help: Reconnect attempts per outage before the adapter waits for the next polling interval. Applies to all devices.
Exponential backoff help: Wait a little longer after each failed reconnect.
Auto discovery help: Off: only known devices and devices added by IP. Searching on the Devices tab still works.
Delay to bundle commands per device: Delay to bundle commands per device
Bundle delay help: Changes to the same device within this time are sent as one command. 0 = never bundle.
